metadata.scope: 2026 腾讯官方列表已收录LPL、MSI、全球先锋赛和EWC，加Riot官方赛程中已结束的德玛西亚杯国际邀请赛；德杯时长来自Games of Legends。不代表全球全赛区覆盖。 另收录ChainCC公开的2026 LCK、LEC、LCS、LCP、CBLOL；不表示所有赛区无缺局。
checks: team ids reconciled per game
kills verified against five players
winner totals compared with series score
gameTime seconds preserved; actual timestamps not used to invent game duration
all maps available only after last actual map end
historical series date is earliest actual game start; original schedule preserved in scheduled_at
Riot finished frames only
five player kills used, independently matched to GOL kills
raw Riot aggregate kills retained for anomaly review
game winners sum to official series score
game duration from published in-game time, never wall clock
series data available only after last finished frame
limitations: 2026Worlds首轮对阵未公布时不生成确定比赛。
旧腾讯来源未提供已核验版本；新增CSV与Riot数据保留其公开版本字段。
逐局时长事实表截至2026-10-07；新增比赛须先补充并核验公开时长，脚本不会猜测时长。
Riot时间为赛事实时数据初始化及完成帧时间；结束帧用于保守限制历史数据可用时间。
